# What does a customer owe after a mid-cycle upgrade, downgrade or cancellation?

> Free proration calculator for SaaS and subscription businesses: enter the billing period, what was billed and the mid-cycle changes, and see each day-count segment, the credit or charge due, tax, the next renewal and what the balance would be on other change dates. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
